name: Władysław Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.note: Partition of Trąbczyn, Nowa Wieś, Osiny and Łazy among the three brothers, made at Trąbczyn.

events.type: Trąbczyn sold in his name by his brothers

citations.page: 7.885.61, 7.885.60; Boniecki, Herbarz polski VII p. 369; Dworzaczek dw.26734 / dw.26726 (DEM x 1701)

notes: Called the younger Władysław here to tell him from his father.
